newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge lower to end at 20.375 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge lower to end at 20.375 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates edged lower on Thursday to close at 20.375 percent compared with 20.50 percent on Wednesday, traders said.
Overnight rates traded in a narrow range between 20.375 and 20.625 percent and traders said they expected the rate to move little on Friday.
Overnight rates tend to hover around the central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo rate that currently stands at 20.25 percent.
